reviews.text: It does everything I expected it to do and even more i waited a long while to write this review as I was trying this product as key part of my skincare routine and just can't believe how much it changed my skin. My pores? Gone. Dark circles? Gone. I don't even know how that happened. It was very gradual but very noticeable. On top of that this one does not dry out my skin AT ALL. This was a VERY pleasant surprise as cosrx toners usually tend to dry my skin out no matter how hard i try to avoid it. If you have dark circles that are persistent even after retinol, i'd suggest you try this one out.
reviews.zh: 佢做到我所期望嘅一切，甚至更多。我等咗好耐先寫呢個評論，因為我一直將呢款產品當做我護膚程序嘅重要一環，而且真係唔敢相信佢令我皮膚改變咁多。我嘅毛孔？冇咗。黑眼圈？冇咗。我真係唔知點會咁。改變好緩慢，但係好明顯。除此之外，呢款一啲都唔會令我皮膚乾燥。呢個係一個非常驚喜嘅發現，因為 cosrx 嘅化妝水通常都會令我皮膚乾燥，不論我點樣避免都一樣。如果你有啲黑眼圈，即使用咗維 A 醇都仲係好頑固，我建議你試吓呢款。

reviews.text: I've been using this toner for awhile now, and it has helped me to keep a clear skin. I use it mostly at night (PM routine) since it contains vitamic C, even if I use sunscreen during the day, because the sun is too strong here in my country. The texture is very light, it's almost like water, has a slight smell, but it's not bad. I usually apply it on wet skin, as soon as I wash my face, I think this way it is absorbed quicker. I'd recommend it 👌🏻
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款化妝水一段時間，佢幫我保持皮膚清透。我主要喺晚上（PM 護膚程序）用，因為佢含有維他命 C，雖然我白天都會擦防曬，因為我所在嘅國家太陽好猛。質地好輕盈，幾乎似水咁，有少少味道，但係唔難聞。我通常喺濕潤嘅皮膚上塗，洗完面就即刻塗，我諗咁樣吸收得快啲。我推薦 👌🏻

reviews.text:
𝚃𝚑𝚎 𝚙𝚛𝚘𝚍𝚞𝚌𝚝 𝚌𝚕𝚊𝚒𝚖𝚜 𝚝𝚘 : 
Help remove excess dead skin cells, clear pores, remove impurities and revitalize tired skin. It also claims to brighten and rejuvenate skin. 
𝙼𝚊𝚒𝚗 𝚒𝚗𝚐𝚛𝚎𝚍𝚒𝚎𝚗𝚝𝚜:
🥭Pitaya extract -provide powerful revitalizing effects 
🥝Kiwi Extract - refine skin texture,regulate sebum and remove dead skin cells

☁️𝙼𝚢 𝚝𝚑𝚘𝚞𝚐𝚑𝚝𝚜 & 𝚎𝚡𝚙𝚎𝚛𝚒𝚎𝚗𝚌𝚎: 
It is certainly not my first AHA BHA toner from @cosrx and this winter I decided to try a new simple, lightweight toner with essential ingredients. I use this toner every night and I noticed how less oily my skin became. But at the same time this toner does not dry my skin. I haven’t noticed any irritation, burning when applied it. It's not sticky and absorbs really quickly on my face. It's refreshing and gives a cooling effect. It seems to brighten, clear my skin and prevent pigmentation🤍 Due to it's thin ,watery texture it does not feel heavy on my skin. So far , I love this gentle toner and the minimalistic packaging✨
reviews.zh:
產品聲稱：
有助去除多餘嘅死皮、清潔毛孔、去除污垢，同埋令疲憊嘅皮膚重現活力。亦聲稱可以提亮同令皮膚煥發光彩。
主要成分：
🥭 火龍果萃取 – 提供強效活化功效
🥝 奇異果萃取 – 改善膚質、調節皮脂，並去除死皮

☁️ 我嘅心得同體驗：
呢個絕對唔係我第一次用 @cosrx 嘅 AHA BHA 化妝水，今個冬天我決定試吓一款簡約、輕盈、成分精簡嘅化妝水。我每晚都用，留意到我嘅皮膚油脂少咗。同時，呢款化妝水唔會令皮膚乾燥。塗抹嗰時，我冇感到任何刺激或者灼熱。佢唔黏，喺面上吸收得好快。好清新，帶嚟清涼感。佢似乎可以提亮、淨化皮膚，又可以預防色素沉澱🤍 由於質地薄、似水，所以塗喺皮膚上唔會覺得厚重。到目前為止，我好鍾意呢款溫和嘅化妝水，同埋佢簡約嘅包裝✨

reviews.text: Love this toner. At first I got the smaller version from a local stor and now I got the big one. This toner is excellent if you put it in a fine mist bottle. Works so gently. I believe clears up skin. During day time I put sunscreen after the skincare routine, so to be safe, still it is not a strong toner and you will not sting like with other AHA products. I got it with other products in a line to fight blackheads, blemishes and to clear skin up in general. So far I love it.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款化妝水。一開始我喺本地店買咗細支裝，而家買咗大支。如果你將佢放入幼霧狀嘅噴瓶入面，效果更加好。非常溫和。我相信可以令皮膚清晰。日間我會喺護膚程序之後擦防曬，所以為咗安全起見，佢仍然唔算強力嘅化妝水，唔會像其他 AHA 產品咁刺痛。我係同其他產品一齊買嘅，用嚟對付黑頭、暗瘡印，同埋令皮膚整體清晰。到目前為止我好鍾意。

reviews.text: This product is effective for real against blackhead. i used it every day for about a week to notice visibly the improvements. it works wonder also for exfoliating, you can peel off dead skin from pimple scars as layers, so satisfying. Although the bad side is that it really dries your skin, after a week of use i changed policy and now i use it once every two days, make sure to apply a good hydratating after.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品對付黑頭真係有效。我每日用咗大約一星期，先明顯見到改善。去角質效果都好好，你可以將痘印位置嘅死皮一層層撕走，好滿足。不過缺點係佢真係會令皮膚好乾。用咗一個星期之後，我改咗做法，而家每兩日先用一次，記得之後要擦好嘅保濕產品。

reviews.text: I have bought and used many different toners and find that this one left the most memorable impression on me. I had been looking to incorporate vitamin C into my nighttime routine, but couldn't decide what to get. CosRX is one of my favorite brands, so when I saw this I definitely had to get it. Do not regret purchasing it. Gentle on the skin, yet moisturizing. Might also be helping brighten my face as well. I have been using it for about 3 months now and have not had any reactions to it.
reviews.zh: 我買過同用過好多款唔同嘅化妝水，而呢款係令我印象最深刻嘅。我一直想將維他命 C 加入晚間護膚程序，但係唔知揀邊款好。CosRX 係我最鍾意嘅品牌之一，所以見到呢款我一定要買。買咗完全唔後悔。對皮膚溫和，但又有保濕效果。亦都可能幫助提亮面部膚色。我已經用咗大約三個月，冇任何不良反應。

reviews.text:
Its only my 3rd day using it but i can already see the difference in my skin! I always thought toner was not really important until my friend told me how important it is. Everyday i always woke up with some white heads or acne that never went away! 
I am mainly using it in evening with cotton pads and pat some in my skin. I am waking up with no acne! I am in love with this product!
reviews.zh:
我用咗只係第三日，已經見到皮膚有分別！我一直都覺得化妝水唔係好重要，直到朋友話俾我聽佢有幾重要。以前我每日醒嚟都長住啲白頭或者暗瘡，好似點都唔會退！
我主要晚上用棉片，輕輕拍喺皮膚上。而家我醒嚟嗰時已經冇暗瘡！我好鍾意呢款產品！

reviews.text: This is a great mild toner, so long as you understand what it is for. This toner is not strong enough for a proper exfoliation, if you are looking for that then you can try COSRX's BHA Blackhead Power Liquid or AHA Whitehead Power Liquid. Those will give better results, but do not overuse them or you will have problems. This toner however, serves as something to be used in between days when you are not exfoliating. Since it is very very mild it doesn't sting, so it should also be good for those with sensitive skin. For oily skinned people like myself, this works well at stopping this skin from clogging up due to oil buildup. I found it especially useful at night, since usually when I wake up my skin is really oily and feels rough, but after using this daily at night (except for nights when I use another chemical exfoliant, in which case I don't combined them on the same night) I noticed that when I wake up my skin is not as oily or clogged. I use the Hydrium Toner in the morning and this at night, and so far they have both been very impressive. Definitely a great addition to the COSRX lineup.
reviews.zh: 只要你明白佢嘅用途，呢款係一款好好嘅溫和化妝水。呢款化妝水唔足夠強去做正式去角質，如果你想要咁嘅效果，可以試吓 COSRX 嘅 BHA Blackhead Power Liquid 或者 AHA Whitehead Power Liquid。嗰啲效果會更好，但係唔好過度使用，否則會出問題。不過呢款化妝水適合用喺唔去角質嘅日子之間。因為佢非常非常溫和，所以唔會刺痛，對敏感皮膚嚟講都應該好好。對於像我咁油性嘅皮膚嚟講，佢能夠好好地防止皮膚因為油脂積聚而堵塞。我覺得佢晚上用特別有用，因為我通常朝早醒嚟時皮膚好油、摸落好粗糙，但係晚晚用呢款（除咗晚上用其他化學去角質產品嘅日子，我就唔會同一晚一齊用），我發現朝早醒嚟皮膚冇咁油，亦冇咁堵塞。我朝早用 Hydrium 化妝水，晚上用呢款，而到目前為止兩款都好出色。絕對係 COSRX 產品線嘅好好補充！
